picks: Aerial over a vast red-carpeted ground: hundreds of white-draped tables in symmetrical rows, truss-mounted stage, LED screen towers, perimeter branding, floodlight masts. Scale, flooring, staging, lighting and audience all in one frame.
Enormous covered pandal with scaffolded tiered galleries, thousands seated, decorated yagna mandap on red carpet. Best single image of temporary large-span covered assembly.
Homa fire and garlanded kalash at dusk. Atmosphere/detail only — no infrastructure.

Fabricated 3D '64th ISGCON' letters on a plinth against a printed Vidhana Soudha backdrop. SELF-VERIFYING: backdrop reads '64TH ANNUAL CONFERENCE ... 21st-24th DECEMBER 2023 BENGALURU'. Branded-environment/fabrication evidence. Low resolution (800x589).

Completed exhibition stand, unoccupied: wood-grain back wall, edge-lit product panels, red LED-neon logo, floodlights, reception counter, lounge set, carpeted platform. The single best 'execution quality' frame in the whole supplied set.
Large custom stand with curved white fascia, illuminated columns, red neon logo, raised platform on a marble convention-hall floor. 3648x2736 camera original — highest resolution supplied.
Same stand as 01, populated with delegates. Good 'in use' companion frame.
A third, different La Renon stand: red/white with timber slat wall, pendant lights, illuminated logo. Confirms multiple separate builds for this client.
Seated audience at draped round tables in a hotel banquet room. 5019x3339 but shows no Raja-built infrastructure.
Delegates at a draped table with theatre-style chair rows behind. Generic corporate interior.
Tensile-membrane canopy on steel masts and cable stays, warmly uplit at dusk over a large seated crowd. Visually outstanding for canopy/lighting/scale. Vertical banner crop (720x1280).
Aerial over a very large covered assembly: broad timber stage with inlay detail, thousands seated, columned canopy running to the horizon.
